description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the ModifyFeatures class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify package. It contains unit tests for immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and handling of oversized feature data.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ModifyFeatures class, testing immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ModifyFeatures class, and its Features and ThingId components, are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies proper implementation of hashCode and equals methods for ModifyFeatures.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatures
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyFeatures instance with null features throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a ModifyFeatures instance from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: modifyTooLargeFeatures
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown when trying to create ModifyFeatures with features exceeding size limit.
